job.job_description:
Were seeking a skilled Webflow Developer to craft responsive, pixel-perfect websites and landing pages. Youll collaborate with our growth and product teams to optimize our site for conversions, SEO, and seamless integrations. This remote role suits India-based talent passionate about no-code development and AI-driven businesses.

Key Responsibilities

Design and build dynamic Webflow sites, including landing pages, blogs, and client portals using Webflows CMS and animations.
Integrate third-party tools like HubSpot, Google Analytics, Zapier, and custom JavaScript for enhanced functionality.
Optimize sites for SEO, speed, and mobile responsiveness using Semrush and Google tools.
Collaborate on A/B tests and CRO experiments to boost user engagement.
Troubleshoot and maintain sites with HTML/CSS/JS tweaks and Figma handoffs.
Support marketing campaigns with rapid page deployments.
Integrate AI Capabilities: Connect Webflow projects with Large Language Model (LLM) APIs (specifically OpenAI/ChatGPT) to build dynamic, AI-powered user experiences.
API Optimization: Architect AI workflows to optimize for latency, token consumption, and cost-efficiency, ensuring fast and reliable responses.
Component Development: Understanding of Storybook for building, testing, and documenting UI components in isolation is a plus.

4+ years of hands-on Webflow experience (certified preferred).
4+ years of Javascript experience and 2+ years of react.
2+ years of GSAP animation experience
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and Webflow Logic/CMS.
Experience with SEO tools (Semrush/Google Analytics), integrations (Zapier/HubSpot), and design tools (Figma).
Strong understanding of responsive design, performance optimization, and CRO best practices.
AI API Integration: Proven experience implementing and managing integrations with AI models like ChatGPT/OpenAI in web applications.
Technical Optimization: Strong understanding of how to optimize AI API calls, including handling rate limits, caching strategies, and minimizing latency.
Cloud Exposure: Basic exposure to AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically understanding concepts like storing secrets or simple script hosting.
Competitive salary
Fully remote work with flexible hours and home office stipend.
Opportunity to shape a high-growth AI startup and work with cutting-edge tech.


Disclaimer: This job posting and Location has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
